card.name: The word than after more
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "than" right after "more" in usage limits, such as "not more than 1 time" or "for more than 3 days". Also fires on a few adverbs or spaces before an amount or an action, like "very" before "slowly".

modes.label: more than
modes.description: The word "than" following "more" when a limit on frequency, duration or amount is stated.
modes.example: Do not use Fluticasone Furoate ELLIPTA more<< than>> 1 time

modes.label: Manner or count words
modes.description: An adverb or gap that comes just before a rate or a quantity in preparation steps.
modes.example: the diluent should be injected<< very>> slowly into the Enbrel vial

card.plain: It lights up on "than" in phrases like "more than once a day" or "more than 3 days" in dosing directions.
